term: evidence cells, coarse observation and exact forecast accuracy
definition: Cell p observed n contains traces satisfying p and agreeing with every observed value through n inclusive. forecast observed n repeats the last observed value for n+1. Accurate requires that forecast equal the next value of every cell member. occupancy reports whether either fixed candidate bearer is present in chains; it deliberately omits bearer identity. globalObservation takes the first component of the existing Int signal at Nat times.
note: Analyst semantic profile, not an epistemic-justification definition, a chance space or a metaphysical accessibility claim. The stipulated global law is included in the cell; a finite observer does not thereby know it. A nonempty cell is separately witnessed. Perfect agreement over the stipulated class is stronger than Goldman’s fallible process reliability. Coarse observation, complete history selection, psychological expectation and normative entitlement stay distinct.
